name: Docling Open-Source Document AI Toolkit
free_limit: MIT-licensed local document parsing and conversion for PDFs, Office files, images and more into structured documents, Markdown or JSON; no vendor software license fee or hosted API quota.
watch_out: Local CPU/GPU, memory, model downloads and storage are required; external inference APIs or hosted infrastructure may charge. Individual model weights can have different licenses and commercial-use restrictions; verify each model separately.
